title: Cost of Government review of county boards
summary: On October 20, 2026, the Cost of Government Commission updated a committee on its study of county boards and commissions, which deferred the item; written testimony is still accepted. The commission reviewed 15 of 37 boards, recommending end dates or regular reviews for new boards and minimum staff support for each. It has since moved on to transportation and disaster readiness.
